title: Linearity of the Boolean noise operator
statement: For a natural number $n$, real numbers $\rho,c,d$, and real-valued functions $f,g$ on $\{0,1\}^n$, the noise operator satisfies $T_\rho(cf+dg)=cT_\rho f+dT_\rho g$.
replaced: Let $T_\rho$ denote Boolean noise with real correlation $\rho$, whose Fourier multiplier on a set of size $k$ is $\rho^k$. For real $c,d,\rho$ and real functions $f,g$ on $\{0,1\}^n$, $T_\rho(cf+dg)=cT_\rho f+dT_\rho g$.
